meta.title: Bulk Vendor Upload: refused for a user without the Implementation Partner role
gaps: Reach and execute Bulk Vendor Upload using an Excel vendor list deduped on PAN as a user without the Implementation Partner role and as an Implementation Partner, then compare the refusal or availability outcomes.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Reach and execute Bulk Vendor Upload using an Excel vendor list deduped on PAN as a user without the Implementation Partner role and as an Implementation Partner, then compare the refusal or availability outcomes.

args.need: sign in as the user without the Implementation Partner role and the Implementation Partner in the same tenant, open Bulk Vendor Upload, attempt the PAN-deduped Excel upload for both users, and record whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog has no Bulk Vendor Upload flow or role-specific login step.
